s marked by extreme and violent energy
s marked by extreme anger
s (of the elements) as if showing violent anger

furnace.translation:
n. 火炉, 熔炉, 考验
vt. 在炉中烧
furnace.definition: n. an enclosed chamber in which heat is produced to heat buildings, destroy refuse, smelt or refine ores, etc.

furnish.translation:
vt. 供给, 提供, 装设
[化] 供应; 供给; 配料
furnish.definition: v. provide or equip with furniture

furnished.translation: a. 家具, 有家具的
furnished.definition: a. provided with whatever is necessary for a purpose (as furniture or equipment or authority)

furniture.definition: n. furnishings that make a room or other area ready for occupancy

further.translation:
a. 更远的, 此外的, 更多的
vt. 促进, 增进, 助长
adv. 更进一步地, 更远地, 此外
further.definition:
s. more distant in especially degree
r. to or at a greater extent or degree or a more advanced stage (`further' is used more often than `farther' in this abstract sense)
r. in addition or furthermore; further, they should be here already"

furthermore.definition: r. in addition; furthermore, their quality is improving"; moreover, mice nested there"

fuse.translation:
n. 保险丝, 导火线
v. 熔化, 融合
fuse.definition:
n. an electrical device that can interrupt the flow of electrical current when it is overloaded
n. any igniter that is used to initiate the burning of a propellant
v. become plastic or fluid or liquefied from heat
v. equip with a fuse; provide with a fuse

fusion.translation:
n. 熔合物, 结合, 熔合
[化] 熔融; 熔化; 聚变
fusion.definition:
n. an occurrence that involves the production of a union
n. the merging of adjacent sounds or syllables or words
n. a nuclear reaction in which nuclei combine to form more massive nuclei with the simultaneous release of energy
n. the combining of images from the two eyes to form a single visual percept

fussy.translation: a. 易怒的, 爱挑剔的, 难取悦的, 易烦恼的
fussy.definition:
s annoyed and irritable
s overcrowded or cluttered with detail
s exacting especially about details

futile.translation: a. 无用的, 琐细的, 不重要的
futile.definition: s. producing no result or effect

future.translation:
n. 未来, 将来
a. 将来的, 未来的
future.definition:
n. the time yet to come
n. a verb tense that expresses actions or states in the future
n. bulk commodities bought or sold at an agreed price for delivery at a specified future date
a. yet to be or coming

fuzz.translation:
n. 细毛, 绒毛, 警察
vi. 作绒毛状飞散, 变成绒毛状
vt. 起毛, 使模糊
fuzz.definition: n. the first beard of an adolescent boy
